facts.fact: Newsday reports a Ministry of Health officer from its Health Management Information Systems (HMIS) Division presenting how health data is collected from communities and facilities, at a workshop reported on 23 September 2026 (workshop dates not stated; publication date used).

systems.tiers: communities and health facilities, tiers not stated
some programmes; others still on paper

note: The HMIS Division says data is collected with a mix of paper-based and electronic registers, and the ICT department that some programmes use electronic registers while others rely on paper (September 2026); the mix fits no single 'digitised' value, so no such fact is recorded. The laboratory information system is not yet fully integrated into the national data warehouse.
